accuracyChecks.method: Two rounds of random items from the generated files (5 per chapter, then 3 per chapter: 112 items) plus one full mock (38 items) re-solved independently by hand (arithmetic re-done, dates checked against the calendar, GST/annuity/correlation values recomputed)
fixes: reused cbse-g11-maths GP family "5th and 7th terms given" dropped here: it gave only r = 2 when r = ±2 both fit
reused cbse-g11-maths limit family that could produce a trivial (p(x))/(p(x)) limit dropped from Applied Mathematics
reused families filtered so that no variant mentions trigonometry (not in the 241 syllabus); slope-from-angle, angle-between-lines, normal-form and trig-limit families excluded
continuity key text "−1a + b" rewritten as "−a + b"; "1 units" wording fixed; f⁻¹ of (ax + b)/(cx + d) normalised to a positive leading denominator
income-tax slabs, cess, GST rates and tariffs are always stated in the question, so answers do not depend on a particular year's rates
